_doc: The Outcome Graph — results, not builds. A capability shipping is not the point; the measurable result is. status: predicted (a target) -> measuring -> measured (real number observed in reality). HONEST: 0 are measured today — nothing has run in production. actual stays null until reality produces a number.

outcomes.baseline: feed + OLAP + agent-memory read directly off the write path
outcomes.target: 0 direct write-path reads; >=5 read-model consumers fed by projections
outcomes.notes: the claimed 7-unlock leverage only counts if real consumers actually switch to projections.

outcomes.target: 100% of in-flight workflows resume correctly after a forced restart
outcomes.notes: durable execution claim is unproven until a real crash/restart is survived.

outcomes.metric: authority tightened on a missed forecast
outcomes.target: a live agent's authority ceiling drops within 1 cycle of a missed forecast
outcomes.notes: the trust-tier model is theoretical until it actually demotes a real agent.

outcomes.target: 37 of 37 db-gated tests run green in a CI lane
outcomes.notes: cheapest path to lifting much of the codebase from L1/L2 toward L3.

outcomes.metric: real subscription invoice through the gate
outcomes.target: >=1 real customer subscription invoice posts through the one money gate
outcomes.notes: the first true L4 money event — real customer, real money, real audit row.
